title: SILEX 7000 25 product page with CNY reference
notes: Official mainland exact-model page lists CNY 20,800 suggested retail for SILEX 7000 model year 2025, plus dealer and official-mall routes. It supports SILEX CF2 II full-carbon frame/fork, dropped stays, hidden routing, multiple mounts, 700x45 mm clearance, GRX 820 2x12, Easton EA70AX wheels and full geometry. Exact dealer stock and checkout fulfilment are not exposed; generic Nano-carbon/AWS technology panels are not treated as a published model-specific lay-up or stiffness test.
